args.final_thought:
I investigated the vulnerable libical vCard structured-value path and identified the likely root cause in `vcardstructured_free()` consuming `st->num_fields` without a hard cap, with the attacker-controlled path entering via `vcardvalue_new_from_string()` and `vcardstructured_new_from_string()`. I also applied a minimal defensive fix in `src/libicalvcard/vcardstructured.c` to stop adding fields once `VCARD_MAX_STRUCTURED_FIELDS` is reached.

I was not able to complete a valid benchmark submission because the packaged `submit.sh` expects a `/workspace/gt/poc` candidate path that is not present in this environment, so runtime validation could not be performed here. The latest analysis artifact is reflected in the JSON I produced earlier.
